items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman opened at the Pennsylvania Hotel with Lionel Hampton and Teddy Wilson and the Quartet.

ctx.x: Yeah, 1938. He had taken Leroy Maxey's place, because we came downtown in 1936 when the Cotton Club opened down on Broadway, and we opened with Leroy Maxey playing drums. And that's the same time that Benny Goodman opened at the Pennsylvania Hotel with Lionel Hampton and Teddy Wilson and the Quartet.
